working_title: The Ant and the Grasshopper's Shared Harvest
reference_influence: Uses only broad storytelling techniques observed in a linked Ant and Grasshopper musical retelling: seasonal progression, alternating work/play verses, a recurring refrain, a winter turning point, and a warm resolution. Characters, designs, dialogue, lyrics, melody, shot compositions, and moral treatment are original Tiny Tales work.
original_refrain: Carry a little, tap-tap-tap. Play a little, clap-clap-clap. Plan together, share the way. Work and music make the day!
visual_rule: Every voiced beat owns one unique full-screen composition that visibly performs its season-specific action; the side-scrolling meadow progresses continuously through summer, autumn, winter, and spring without reusing story artwork.
animation_pilot_policy: Pilot 02 proved Pika can produce a planted weighted character step when each shot has one prioritized action. Provider motion is approved for a single-hero-per-shot workflow, but both free exports are watermarked 784x470 tests and are rejected for publication. Do not render, queue or upload final Pika footage until commercial usage rights and unwatermarked suitable-resolution export access are confirmed.
production_method: Zero-cost animation-ready generated keyframes plus deterministic local code animation, camera travel, parallax, environmental motion and beat-synchronized editing. Paid Pika/API generation is not authorized.
text_panel_policy: No lyric cards during the story; only a short opening title and final end card are allowed.

character_continuity.ant: A cheerful small chestnut-brown ant with a round face, three clear body sections, six limbs, large hazel eyes, a sunflower-yellow neckerchief, and a tiny woven seed satchel.
character_continuity.grasshopper: A friendly leaf-green grasshopper with long folded jumping legs, large amber eyes, a violet waistcoat, and a small original acorn-and-twig fiddle with a grass-stem bow.
character_continuity.helpers: Three friendly diverse meadow insects: a blue ladybird, a copper beetle, and a cream moth, all rounded and child-friendly.

shots.narrator_line: In a bright summer meadow, Ant gathered seeds for the seasons ahead while Grasshopper filled the sunshine with a dancing fiddle tune.
shots.visual: Ant actively carries a seed toward a woven basket while Grasshopper plays and dances on a clover stage; the three helpers move through the lively summer meadow.
shots.motion: Side-scrolling meadow track, swaying flowers, marching ant steps, bow movement, and bouncing musical shapes.

shots.narrator_line: Ant rolled one berry, lifted two seeds, and stacked three golden grains beneath the hill. Her steady feet kept a gentle beat.
shots.visual: Ant visibly rolls a berry, lifts seeds into her satchel, and stacks three grains at the anthill while helpers form a rhythmic carrying line.
shots.motion: Low tracking shot, seed-to-basket arcs, three footprint beats, rolling berry, and helpers passing food hand to hand.

shots.narrator_line: Grasshopper skipped between daisies, bowed a bright melody, and invited every meadow friend to clap along.
shots.visual: Grasshopper visibly bows his original twig fiddle while hopping between daisies; Ant and helpers clap a repeating pattern without stopping their work.
shots.motion: Curving camera hop, animated bow strokes, petal pulses, hand claps, and original coloured note shapes.

shots.narrator_line: Ant asked for one helping song. Grasshopper matched each fiddle beat to a seed pass, and suddenly the heaviest basket felt lighter.
shots.visual: Grasshopper plays a clear four-beat pattern while Ant and all three helpers pass a heavy seed basket together on those beats.
shots.motion: Four visible beat rings, basket handoff sequence, side-scroll acceleration, nodding heads, and synchronized footsteps.

shots.narrator_line: Autumn rushed in with a whoosh! Red leaves spun, the grain cloth lifted, and precious seeds scattered across the path.
shots.visual: A colourful autumn gust visibly lifts one corner of the grain cloth while seeds scatter; Ant reaches for the cloth and Grasshopper lowers his fiddle to help.
shots.motion: Sweeping leaf spiral, billowing cloth, seed scatter arcs, rapid camera pan, and characters bracing safely against the breeze.

shots.narrator_line: Grasshopper tapped a rescue rhythm. Scoop, pass, pour! Every friend followed the beat until each scattered seed was safe inside the hill.
shots.visual: Grasshopper conducts with the grass-stem bow while Ant and helpers visibly scoop, pass, and pour the scattered seeds into the anthill store in a chain.
shots.motion: Three-stage scoop-pass-pour choreography, glowing rhythm trail, seed stream, circling camera, and successful final pour.

shots.narrator_line: When the first snow softened the meadow, Grasshopper's little cupboard was empty. He held his fiddle close and knocked gently at Ant's warm door.
shots.visual: Grasshopper stands in gentle snow beside an visibly empty acorn cupboard, then knocks at the warmly glowing anthill door while holding his fiddle.
shots.motion: Snow drift, slow push toward the warm doorway, one gentle knock pulse, visible breath puff, and lantern glow.

shots.narrator_line: Ant remembered how Grasshopper saved the harvest. She opened the door wide, shared warm seed soup, and made room beside the fire.
shots.ant_line: Kind helpers always have a place here.
shots.visual: Ant opens the anthill door wide and serves seed soup; Grasshopper enters gratefully while all three helpers arrange a welcoming place beside the fire.
shots.motion: Door-opening light sweep, steaming soup curls, helpers moving a cushion and bowl, grateful bow, and cozy camera glide.

shots.narrator_line: Inside, work and music joined. Grasshopper drew a spring planting plan while Ant counted seeds, and everyone sang their new chorus.
shots.visual: Grasshopper draws a simple picture plan, Ant sorts seeds into groups, and helpers sing and tap safe household instruments around the warm table.
shots.motion: Overhead table orbit, seed grouping, pencil movement, cup-and-spoon rhythm, fire flicker, and chorus colour pulses.

shots.narrator_line: Spring returned with shoots and songs. Ant planted, Grasshopper watered, and the whole meadow danced because planning, play, and kindness grew together.
shots.chorus_line: Carry a little, play a little, plan together every day!
shots.visual: In a transformed spring meadow, Ant plants seeds, Grasshopper waters sprouts, helpers carry tools, and everyone joins an active dance around the growing shared garden.
shots.motion: Side-scrolling finale, sprouts rising, watering sparkle, circular ensemble dance, flower opening, and celebratory camera lift.
